item.title: Fire evacuations lifted at hotel in Estes Park
item.description: The evacuation order was for only one address, 1701 N. Lake Ave Estes Park, the address for Expedition Lodge Estes Park. No other areas were ordered to evacuate.

item.title: Colorado lawmakers look to clear a path for portable, plug-in solar panels as bill clears first committee vote
item.description: HB26-1007 seeks to create a regulatory framework in Colorado for portable, plug-in solar panels — systems that do not require approval from electric providers to install, unlike rooftop solar.

item.title: Space Command offers retention, relocation bonuses for civilians to move from Colo. Springs to Alabama
item.description: Ahead of the U.S. Space Command headquarters relocation from Colorado Springs to Alabama, civilian staff are being enticed to move cross country through several bonuses.
